name: Aaron and Israel at the golden calf
charge: Idolatry within weeks of the covenant
summary: While Moses was on the mountain receiving the law that forbade it, the people made a golden calf and worshipped it. The covenant was broken almost before the ink was dry.
offense: Impatient at Moses' delay, they pressed Aaron, who gathered their gold and cast a calf; they declared it the god that brought them out of Egypt and rose up to play. Aaron built it an altar and proclaimed a feast.
judgment: Moses ground the calf to powder and made them drink it. The Levites, called to the Lord's side, put about three thousand to the sword, and the Lord sent a plague on the people. Aaron was spared but not excused.
